transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Mostly I’m here because I’m just… tired. Like, not normal tired, I guess. Sleep doesn’t really fix it. Even little things, like unloading the dishwasher, feel like a whole project. I’ve been trying to read for this certificate class too, and sometimes I just stare at the page and think, why is this so hard? I mean, the dishwasher thing sounds silly, but it piles up, and then I start thinking about how my kitchen looks, and—yeah. The tiredness is the main reason I came in.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest in activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. It’s not even that I’m crying all the time or anything, it’s more like I just stopped caring about the stuff that usually feels like me. I used to sketch a lot, and I’d go to gallery openings—sometimes just for the little cheese cubes, honestly—but I liked being around the art. And cooking, yoga, even tennis with my friend… I keep saying I’ll do it and then I just don’t. It’s like the interest isn’t there.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yeah, a little. I mean, I’m not dieting or anything—if anything I keep meaning to get groceries, and then I get distracted by, like, whether the store is going to be crowded, and then I just don’t go. Some days I’ll notice it’s afternoon and I’ve had coffee and maybe a few bites of something, like a piece of toast or whatever. And my jeans have been looser, which I didn’t really think about at first, but… yeah, I guess I’ve lost some weight without trying.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up a lot during the night, or sleeping more than usual?

I don’t know… I haven’t really tracked it closely. Some nights feel kind of messy, but I couldn’t tell you if I’m waking up a lot or if I just think I slept badly because the next day feels weird. I used to have this alarm app that showed little charts, but then it kept sending me notifications and I deleted it because it annoyed me. So… I guess I’m not sure.
Have you noticed yourself thinking more slowly than usual or feeling restless, like you can't sit still?

Yeah… more slow than restless, I think. Like on my slower days it feels like my body is moving through wet cement. Even if my spouse asks me something really simple—like where I put a mug or whether I want tea—I just sort of… pause there, like my brain is buffering. Which is annoying because I’m usually the one who answers too fast, honestly. But lately sometimes it takes me a weirdly long time to get words out.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt this way for an extended period?

I’m not really sure. Like, I know I’ve had stretches where I was “off,” but I don’t know if it was the same as this or for how long. I’m bad at keeping track of time—my calendar is full of half-entered reminders and then, like, three grocery lists in different notes apps for some reason. So… maybe? But I couldn’t say clearly, no.
Have you ever had a period where you felt this way for two weeks or more, where it really affected your daily life?

Yeah… I think this one has definitely been more than two weeks. I keep wanting to say “a little while,” but if I’m honest it’s probably been like… three months? The quieter version of it, where I’m just not really interested in much and I feel heavy and tired a lot.

It’s weird because I’ll lose track—like I’ll think, oh, that was just last week, and then I realize it was before some appointment or before we replaced the kitchen trash can, which for some reason is how my brain dates things now. But yeah, it’s been long enough that it’s been messing with normal life.
Have you had multiple times in the past when you felt this way for several weeks or longer, or has this mostly been a new experience for you?

I don’t really know, honestly. I can’t tell if this is “multiple times” or if I’m kind of lumping different bad patches together after the fact.

Like, I remember periods where I was not myself, but then I’ll start thinking about whether that was weeks or just… a messy month where a bunch of normal life stuff happened, and then I get stuck trying to remember what year it was. I’m not great with timelines. I have this drawer with old receipts and appointment cards, and sometimes I find one and it’s like, oh, that was two years ago? So… I wouldn’t want to say yes confidently.

This current one feels more noticeable to me, I guess. But whether it’s totally new or just the first time I’m paying attention, I’m not sure.
Have you had multiple separate times in your life when you felt this way for several weeks or longer, or has this mostly been a new experience for you?

I wish I had a cleaner answer, but I really don’t. It doesn’t feel totally new, but I can’t honestly separate out “that was a real separate several-week thing” from “I was just having a rough stretch and time got blurry.”

Like, I’ll remember being sort of shut down before, but then I start thinking about what apartment I was in, or whether it was before my friend got that awful couch she kept for way too long, and then I’m lost. So… maybe there have been other times, but I can’t say for sure. This is the one I’m most aware of right now.
Can you think of any other times in your life when you felt this way for several weeks or longer, even if you didn’t seek help for it?

I’m trying to think, but nothing comes up clearly enough for me to say, like, yes, that was definitely several weeks. I remember feeling off at different points, but then my brain starts sorting it by random things—like where I was living, or what grocery store I used to go to—and I lose the thread.

So… maybe? But I don’t really have a solid example. I didn’t really keep track back then, and honestly I’m not great at realizing how long something has been going on until someone asks me like this.
Can you recall if you’ve had more than one time in your life when you felt this way for several weeks or longer, even if you didn’t talk to anyone about it at the time?

I’m not sure. I keep trying to line it up in my head, but it turns into this whole weird timeline problem, like where I was living or what season it was, and then I start remembering completely useless details instead.

So… I can’t really say there was more than one definite time. It feels possible, but I don’t want to just guess and make it sound more certain than it is. Right now I can only say this is the one I’m actually noticing clearly.
Can you think of any other distinct times in your life, separate from this current episode, when you felt this way for several weeks or longer—even if you didn’t talk to anyone about it at the time?

I mean… I keep circling around it, but no, I can’t pull up a distinct other time that I’m confident was several weeks or longer. I have these vague memories of not feeling like myself, but then I start getting stuck on random details—like which place I was living in, or what bus route I used to take—and it doesn’t really answer your question.

So I guess the honest answer is I’m not sure. I don’t have another clear episode I can point to.
Can you recall if there was a time before this current episode when you felt better for at least a couple of months, and then later had another period where you felt this way again?

I don’t really know. I’m trying to picture it like… okay, was there a stretch where I felt normal for a couple months and then it came back, but then I start thinking about totally unrelated markers, like what apartment I was in or whether it was before or after I had this one couch, which is not helpful.

So I can’t honestly say yes to that. I don’t have a clear memory of it happening in that pattern. It might have, but I’d be guessing.
Can you recall a time when you felt clearly better for several months, and then later had another period where you felt the way you’re describing now?

I’m sorry, I’m still not able to pin that down. Like, when you say “clearly better for several months,” I start trying to measure it against random stuff—where I was living, what classes I was taking, even what the weather was like—and then I kind of lose the actual point.

I don’t have a clear memory of, yes, I was better for months and then later it came back like this. It could have happened, but I can’t say that confidently.
Can you recall if you’ve been feeling this way, more days than not, for most of the past 2 years?

No, not for two years. I mean, when you say “most of the past 2 years,” I start thinking back through everything and I can get kind of lost in it, but… this whole pattern really feels more like about four months.

It kind of started around when the arguments with my spouse got a lot more frequent. That’s the point I can actually connect it to, not like a full two-year stretch.

Can you recall if you've had more than one separate time in your life before this current episode when you felt this way for several weeks or longer, even if you didn't talk to anyone about it at the time?

I’m not sure. I keep trying to sort of scan backward and make a timeline, but then I get stuck on things that probably don’t matter, like where I was living or what year someone got married, and then I lose track of what I’m actually trying to answer.

I can’t clearly say, yes, there were more than one separate times before this. Maybe there were moments or patches, but “several weeks or longer” as a separate episode… I don’t really have a solid answer for that.

Can you think back and clearly identify more than one separate time in your life before this current episode when you felt this way for several weeks or longer, even if you didn’t talk to anyone about it at the time?

I know you asked that already, and I’m trying not to just dodge it, but… I still can’t clearly identify more than one separate time like that.

When I think back, I start getting pulled into other details, like what apartment I was in or whether I was in school then, and then I’m not really answering the question anymore. I can remember being unhappy or stressed at different points, sure, but whether those were separate periods that lasted several weeks and felt like this… I don’t know. I can’t say that clearly.

Can you think back and clearly identify more than one separate time in your life before this current episode when you felt this way for several weeks or longer, even if you didn’t talk to anyone about it at the time?

I’m still not able to clearly pick out more than one separate time, no. I keep trying to make it neat in my head, like, “Okay, that was one episode, and that was another,” but then I start remembering random things around it—like jobs I applied for, or what my friends were doing then—and it gets all mixed together.

So… I can say I’ve had rough patches before, but I can’t honestly say there were more than one times that lasted several weeks and were definitely like this.
